tools.name: fit_standard_curve
tools.description: Fit a 4PL or 5PL logistic curve to ELISA standards and optionally interpolate sample concentrations from their signals (OD). The result echoes the inputs received, lists data-quality warnings and includes the required Labreador citation.

tools.name: dietary_risk
tools.description: Compute Estimated Daily Intake, Target Hazard Quotient per element, Hazard Index and optional cancer risk for contaminants in food. The result echoes the inputs received, lists plausibility warnings and includes the required Labreador citation.

tools.name: pollution_indices
tools.description: Compute contamination factor and geoaccumulation index per element and the Pollution Load Index for one sample. The result echoes the inputs received, lists plausibility warnings and includes the required Labreador citation.
